      title: Owner fields

      type: object
      properties:

          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name

          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. It is normalized by removing every
            non-digit character and must contain exactly 10 digits afterwards; the
            normalized 10-digit value is stored and returned. The pattern enforces the
            "exactly 10 digits" rule while tolerating separators (spaces, parentheses,
            hyphens, etc.) that are stripped during normalization.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\D*(\d\D*){10}$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional, but when present it must be a
            syntactically valid email address. The value is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 3
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone

      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:

              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-

                stored first and last names.
              type: string

              readOnly: true
            initials:

              description: >-
                The pet owner's initials as the upper-cased first letters of the

              type: string

            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.

              items:

            - pets

          title: Content
          description: Pet owners in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:

@RequestMapping("/api")
public class OwnerRestControllerV2 implements OwnerV2Api {

    private final ClinicService clinicService;
    private final OwnerMapper ownerMapper;

    public OwnerRestControllerV2(ClinicService clinicService, OwnerMapper ownerMapper) {
        this.clinicService = clinicService;
        this.ownerMapper = ownerMapper;
    }

    @Override
    @PreAuthorize("hasRole(@roles.OWNER_ADMIN)")
    public ResponseEntity<OwnerPageDto> listOwnersPage(String lastName, Integer page, Integer size) {
        int pageNumber = page == null ? 0 : page;
        int pageSize = size == null ? 20 : size;
        Page<Owner> owners = this.clinicService.findOwners(
            lastName,
            PageRequest.of(pageNumber, pageSize, Sort.by("id")));
        return new ResponseEntity<>(ownerMapper.toOwnerPageDto(owners), HttpStatus.OK);
    }
}

    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:

          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true

          title: Schema validation errors

          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message

      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message

          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true

      properties:
        firstName:

          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. It is normalized by removing every
            non-digit character and must contain exactly 10 digits afterwards; the
            normalized 10-digit value is stored and returned. The pattern enforces the
            "exactly 10 digits" rule while tolerating separators (spaces, parentheses,
            hyphens, etc.) that are stripped during normalization.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\D*(\d\D*){10}$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional, but when present it must be a
            syntactically valid email address. The value is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 3
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
